shapes: allosteric: cooperative regulation as a Hill function
autocatalysis: a product that catalyses its own formation
autoregulated_gene: a gene whose product regulates its own promoter
bi_substrate: an enzyme with two substrates, ordered or ping-pong
binding: two partners forming a complex
bistable_feedback: one species driving its own production, with two stable levels
branch_point: one metabolite drawn on by two enzymes
competition: several enzymes competing for one substrate pool
competition_noun: competition between several enzymes for one substrate
conversion: A -> B with no catalyst
cooperative_enzyme: sigmoidal kinetics or cooperative ligand binding
enzyme_cascade: N catalytic steps, product to substrate
feedback_inhibition: feedback inhibition of a linear pathway, with the feedback point named not guessed
feedforward_loop: a three-node feed-forward loop, coherent or incoherent
futile_cycle: two opposing enzymes turning one pool over
gene_expression: transcription and translation as separate stages
gpcr_cycle: an agonist-occupied receptor driving a G protein cycle
inhibition: Michaelis-Menten with an inhibitor
metabolic_pathway: N reversible segments in series, none able to run uphill
michaelis_menten: one enzyme turning one substrate into one product
moiety_cycle: a conserved cofactor pool, or a step that spends one
mwc_allostery: the concerted two-state model of an allosteric enzyme
open_system: a fed reactor with no conservation over the fed species
phosphorylation_cascade: N phosphorylation cycles, each tier activating the next
receptor_internalisation: ligand-bound receptor removed from the surface pool
repressilator: three genes repressing each other in a ring
reversible_step: an enzymatic step that runs in both directions
scaffold_assembly: a scaffold whose activity has an optimum, not a maximum
signalling_oscillator: a delayed negative feedback loop, the general form of a clock
substrate_channeling: an intermediate passed between enzymes, never entering the bulk
synthesis: one species, expressed and removed
toggle_switch: two genes each repressing the other
transport: a carrier, pump or coupled transporter across a boundary
turnover: a species made and removed, first-order or saturable
two_component_system: a sensor kinase handing a phosphoryl group to a regulator
ultrasensitive_cycle: a covalent modification cycle, sharp when both arms saturate
